thread:
Elaine (Sales): Passing Mandrake Therapeutics to CS. They signed last week — 10 reserved seats, plan is Dedicated + Private (VPC) with optional HSM. Contract starts 2026-04-15, pilot target 2026-05-03.

Elaine (Sales): Quick context: enterprise legal asked for data residency + audit trail. They will use Okta SSO and want model pinning for auditability (no automatic upgrades). Expect medium-volume traffic: ~1k reqs/day, p95 target ~150ms.

Elaine (Sales): Primary contacts — Simon (PM) simon@mandrake.com, Natalie (Security/Legal). Sales handoff notes attached (we pasted key bits below). Main risks: SSO config timing, network ops for private deploy, and renewal chatter — they asked for a 6mo review clause.

Elaine (Sales): Owners: Omar (CS) = onboarding owner, Sasha (Support) = support runbook + oncall, Ben (Eng) = infra scope for private deployment. Action items I want in the first 2 weeks: kickoff call, access collection, infra scoping ticket.

Omar (CS): Thanks Elaine — I'll schedule kickoff for next Tue (2026-04-07) 10am PT. Can @Simon and @Natalie confirm Okta SAML SP metadata and a test Okta sandbox account?

Omar (CS): Also need SSO user mapping and expected groups (we'll map seats). Simon, are there any custom attributes we should expect?

Sasha (Support): Adding myself. For private deploy runbook I need: expected log retention (days), alerting emails, and whether they need token-level tracing. We should plan for 90-day retention unless they ask otherwise.

Sasha (Support): Also please give us the contact for their infra/network (for VPN & firewall rules) — we need firewall ip allowlist for the private node.

Ben (Eng): Heads-up — for private/VPC + HSM we'll need infra ticket + security review. ETA to triage after kickoff: 5 business days. Can someone confirm model(s) to pin (name + version)? Quantization OK?

Ben (Eng): Example infra ticket template I'll use: ```infra create --component=private-deploy --customer=Mandrake --due=2026-04-20 --desc="SSO + HSM + model pinning scoping"```

Elaine (Sales): Model is `open-rlm/large-1.2` pinned to v1.2. Sales ok'd 8-bit quantization for cost savings but they insisted on end-to-end test with sample PHI prompts first.

Omar (CS): Noted. I'll collect sample prompts from Simon and run baseline evals in staging. Req for support/eng: please hold a 1hr triage after kickoff to confirm SSO flow and network plan.

Sasha (Support): Copy. I'll draft runbook and checklist items: Okta metadata, cert thumbprint, firewall ips, logging/retention, escalation path, rollback plan. Will share in this thread when ready.

Ben (Eng): Added dependency: if they want an HSM for key wrap we need KMS+HSM integration details. If they want HSM on-prem, that changes timeline. Please flag now.

Elaine (Sales): They requested cloud HSM (customer-managed keys via their KMS provider). Simon will share KMS ARN.

deploy-bot: New task created -> "mandrake-private-scoping" assigned to Ben, Sasha; due 2026-04-20.

Omar (CS): Great — I'll compile a one-pager for the kickoff with owners, timeline, and success criteria (pilot up and serving three demo apps). Will post here by EOD Friday. :thumbsup:

Elaine (Sales): Thanks team. Tag me if any procurement or billing questions come up (I still own billing until handoff complete).

Sasha (Support): Quick question — who owns post-pilot training for product admins? CS or Sales?

Omar (CS): CS owns product admin enablement. I'll plan two enablement sessions (admin + end-user) during week 2 of pilot.

Elaine (Sales): Perfect. Closing handoff note — priorities: 1) Kickoff scheduled 2) SSO metadata 3) Infra scoping ticket 4) Runbook draft.

Omar (CS): Closing note: I'll update this thread with kickoff invite and shared doc link.

Ben (Eng): I'll post infra triage notes after the kickoff.

Sasha (Support): Will share runbook draft by Mon 2026-04-06.

Elaine (Sales): :rocket:
